description:
Sometimes being “selfish” is the most selfless thing you can do.

You can’t pour into your family, your team, or your purpose if you’re running on empty.

Put your oxygen mask on first. Get healthy. Get clear. Get strong.

Not so you can have more…but so you can give more for the rest of your life.
transcript: got to be selfish for a short period of time so you can be selfless for the rest of your life. You see, so many of you, if you're here, you're the go-to person that most people know. And the thought of being a little selfish with your time, with your effort, it almost goes against your nature, almost goes against your character. But if you keep giving to everybody else and don't leave enough for you, then you never actually get to live into your full potential. And that's how you can serve the people you love the most.
